arxiv-2310-09387.title: Mass Spectrum of Non-Charmed and Charmed Meson States in Extended Linear-Sigma Model Preprint: ECTP-2023-11 Preprint: WLCAPP-2023-11
arxiv-2310-09387.creator: Azar I. Ahmadov, Abdel Nasser Tawfik
arxiv-2310-09387.description: Abstract For scalar and pseudoscalar meson fields and the up, down, strange and charm quark flavors, we construct the effective Lagrangian of the extended linear-sigma model (eLSM). Based on its global chiral symmetry, analytical expressions for the masses of the scalar, pseudoscalar, vector and axial-vector meson states are derived. The various eLSM parameters are determined, analytically and estimated, numerically.

arxiv-2405-06189.title: Holonomic swap and controlled-swap gates of neutral atoms via selective Rydberg pumping
arxiv-2405-06189.creator: C. F. Sun, X. Y. Chen, W. L. Mu, G. C. Wang, J. B. You, X. Q. Shao
arxiv-2405-06189.description: Abstract Holonomic quantum computing offers a promising paradigm for quantum computation due to its error resistance and the ability to perform universal quantum computations. Here, we propose a scheme for the rapid implementation of a holonomic swap gate in neutral atomic systems, based on the selective Rydberg pumping mechanism.

arxiv-2406-12503.description: Abstract Adapting Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models to new domains leads to Catastrophic Forgetting (CF) of previously learned information. This paper addresses CF in the challenging context of Online Continual Learning (OCL), with tasks presented as a continuous data stream with unknown boundaries.

arxiv-2512-03983.title: Statistical hypothesis testing for differences between layers in dynamic multiplex networks
arxiv-2512-03983.creator: Maximilian Baum, Francesco Sanna Passino, Axel Gandy
arxiv-2512-03983.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maximilian Baum, Francesco Sanna Passino, Axel Gandy. Abstract

With the emergence of dynamic multiplex networks, corresponding to graphs where multiple types of edges evolve over time, a key inferential task is to determine whether the layers associated with different edge types differ in their connectivity. In this work, we introduce a hypothesis testing framework, under a latent space network model, for assessing whether the layers share a common latent representation.

pmc-13465597.description: Simple SummaryUnknown-primary Merkel cell carcinoma (UPMCC) is a rare presentation in which metastatic MCC is detected in lymph nodes without an identifiable skin tumour.
